label: PF Backlog 616
title: Post-sync revalidation: after sync_develop/merge, run the affected gates+tests to detect merge-induced breakage (fix-needed vs fine)
body: When a session resyncs develop (sync_develop merges origin/develop into the branch) or before pushing to develop, other sessions may have changed architecture/design. After a clean merge the branch may be broken by the COMBINATION even though there was no textual conflict. Requirement: after sync_develop/merge, run the affected gates + scoped tests (fast tier) and report whether the branch is broken (must fix) or fine, and check cross-architecture/design compatibility vs the re-synced develop. Also re-run on push-to-develop (pre-push) so a merge-induced regression is caught before landing.

objective: Detect and report merge-induced breakage after every resync/merge, before push/merge to develop.
acceptance_criteria: sync_develop runs the fast tier + scoped tests after a clean merge and reports PASS (fine) / FAIL (fix needed).
Pre-push to develop revalidates the branch against the re-synced develop (architecture/design compatibility).
A source conflict still aborts cleanly (unchanged); a clean-but-breaking merge is surfaced with the failing gate/test and the offending change.
Output states clearly: "current is fine" vs "current is broken - fix before proceeding".
